label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: Country pop-up and cookie banner covered the page at the start, and the country pop-up kept offering to switch to [name] until I chose stay on this site
Product list was missing on first read and only appeared after reading again, so it looked like an empty page
Add to cart buttons have no product name, only the price, so many products share near identical button names and I cannot tell which product I am adding
After adding to cart the bag drawer first said the cart was empty with 0 items, and only updated on a later read, with no clear confirmation of the add

Product shade options are radio buttons, each followed by a repeated line saying activating this element will cause content to update, which is noisy; the product link text is just the shade name, not the product
